contract_check_scope: The fixed database is checked against all official Environment DBMS_facts and bound_constraints plus explicit row NULL/value equalities. This is a complete check of that encoded premise, not an independent proof that the source constraint translator implements every intended raw contract.
known_constraint_translation_boundary: Another task is auditing a literal-left comparison direction issue in official add_constraints. This registration uses column-left comparisons/equalities, NOT NULL and explicit column BETWEEN; it does not rely on the identified literal-left form. No official source or original constraint has been modified.
independent_review_status: The v4 kernel and fair_v4 integration were independently statically reviewed. The additional fixed_oracle_check.py has AST validation and author review only; the independent reviewer moved to contract_bridge_v1 and has not completed this script review. Parent controls any actual execution.
no_algorithm_success_inference: An expected overflow rejection may make a fixed-control check match its analytical expectation; it is never counted as successful query equivalence or as a performance win.
